name: DogeGo ZK Layer 2
author: DogeGo
description: Optional zkproof-v1 overlay: tx-anchored ZK proofs with off-L1 OP_CHECKZKP verify. Inspired by Dogecoin #3869; no protocol fork.

rpc.name: installdefaultvk
rpc.help: Install bundled demo Groth16 verifying key to data/vk/default.vk.

rpc.name: submitproof
rpc.help: Accept a tx-anchored ZK proof after off-L1 CheckZKP verify.

rpc.name: generateproof
rpc.help: Generate a demo Groth16 proof (requires default VK).

rpc.name: checkzkp
rpc.help: Alias for verifyproof (OP_CHECKZKP analogue off L1).

rpc.name: proofroot
rpc.help: Overlay ProofRoot for a Dogecoin block (not in L1 header).

rpc.name: listanchors
rpc.help: List indexed optional ZKDG OP_RETURN anchors.

rpc.name: prepareanchor
rpc.help: Prepare optional ZKDG anchor + signmessage payload.

rpc.name: signanchor
rpc.help: Prepare anchor and sign via wallet_rpc (walletpassphrase + signer_address).

rpc.name: submitl2block
rpc.help: Store an L2 block in local Pebble index.
